rows.jyutping: do1 fong1 min6 ge3 nang4 lik6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for having abilities in many different areas.

example.english: Their versatility lets them do video production as well as design.
example.traditional: 佢有多方面嘅能力，做設計之餘仲識整片。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 do1 fong1 min6 ge3 nang4 lik6 zou6 cit3 gai3 zi1 jyu4 zung6 sik1 zing2 pin3

rows.note: Use this idiom when stressing that someone has a wide range of practical skills or talents.

example.english: Being an event host really takes versatility: you need to speak well, create a good atmosphere, and handle unexpected situations.
example.traditional: 做活動主持真係要有十八般武藝，識講嘢、識搞氣氛，仲要識執生。
example.jyutping: zou6 wut6 dung6 zyu2 ci4 zan1 hai6 jiu3 jau5 sap6 baat3 bun1 mou5 ngai6 sik1 gong2 je5 sik1 gaau2 hei3 fan1 zung6 jiu3 sik1 zap1 saang1
